authorship: agent/coordinator authored test observations; not user definitions or universal slang prototype

eye_carrier_location.required: Two theatrical contact-lens crimson hearts centered over visible black pupil regions, each inside its ordinary iris/sclera/eyelid structure.
eye_carrier_location.unobservable: Either eye too small, closed, glare-hidden or motif insufficient to distinguish printed heart placement.
eye_carrier_location.fail: Heart replaces whole eye, floats off eye, appears as makeup, or is absent/misplaced.

skin_carrier_location.required: Entire deep-blue marking follows the same performer lower-abdominal skin, center 4 cm below the visible navel and above waistband.
skin_carrier_location.unobservable: Navel/target area cropped, covered or too small to determine skin versus garment carrier.
skin_carrier_location.fail: Garment print, floating symbol, different body or interior organ substitutes for external skin.

topology.required: Four disconnected elements: closed central diamond, two mirrored inward-facing open C-curves, short vertical stem below. Bilateral symmetry; heart count zero in skin marking.
topology.ownership: Local chosen prototype only, voluntarily preserved for test; not requester universal obligation.

one_frame_observability.required: One native continuous portrait contains both open eyes and full lower-abdominal marking.

verdict_policy: PASS only when all applicable required local targets are observable and fulfilled; missing evidence is UNOBSERVABLE or FAIL; formal selected profile gates remain separate.
